why_it_wins: Two color-coded phones, hands, eye-lines, and shared body movement prove the joke before text.
typography_and_aspect_plan: Keep exact copy in upper warm negative space; large faces/hands/phones in lower two-thirds; compose separate native 4:5 and 9:16 frames.

slide_visual_blueprint.blueprint: Cozy home evening, low table or sofa edge. Aachu holds her phone close to the viewer with a large harmless app verification timer reading 30 seconds. Zuv sits beside her with his own phone showing a tiny OTP message. Both realize the countdown has turned a normal task into a mission.
slide_visual_blueprint.blocking: Aachu leans forward, thumb ready to type, eyes wide at the timer. Zuv angles his phone toward her, brows lifted. Their shoulders are close but not posed.

slide_visual_blueprint.blueprint: Zuv reads the OTP from his phone too calmly while Aachu types into her phone too fast. Both phones are visible, with the countdown still implied on her screen.
slide_visual_blueprint.blocking: Zuv tracks the digits with one finger and speaks with a serious calm face. Aachu leans toward him, thumb hovering over her phone, impatient eyes locked on the numbers.

slide_visual_blueprint.blueprint: The digit confusion lands physically. Zuv's finger partly covers one digit on his OTP phone. Aachu's thumb freezes mid-type over her phone. Both eye-lines snap to the screens at the same time.
slide_visual_blueprint.blocking: Aachu pauses with a dramatic frozen face, one hand mid-air. Zuv tilts his phone closer, squinting at the half-covered digit. Their heads lean into the same tiny problem.

slide_visual_blueprint.blueprint: Aachu's phone shows one large simple expired state. Both stare at the screen in silence like the timer personally betrayed them.
slide_visual_blueprint.blocking: Aachu holds the phone still, shoulders dropped. Zuv stops mid-read, phone lowered slightly. Both faces are deadpan and stunned.

slide_visual_blueprint.blueprint: They physically reset. Aachu and Zuv move closer side by side, both phones angled toward each other on the table, hands nearly overlapping as they prepare the resend. The retry looks like a tiny mission-control operation.
slide_visual_blueprint.blocking: Aachu exhales, one hand steadying her phone. Zuv leans in, finger ready to read slower this time. Their shoulders touch lightly.

slide_visual_blueprint.blueprint: The app screen shows a simple submitted checkmark. Both release the tension at once with a tiny celebration: eye contact, shared exhale, small relieved smile, shoulders dropping.
slide_visual_blueprint.blocking: Aachu still holds her phone, but her face has opened into relief. Zuv looks at her instead of the phone, amused that they survived it.

slide_visual_blueprint.blueprint: Both phones are face-down after the crisis. Aachu and Zuv lean back together laughing softly, like they survived something far bigger than a normal OTP. The cozy home scene feels complete and ordinary again.
slide_visual_blueprint.blocking: Aachu leans back with a bright laugh, one hand near her chest. Zuv leans back beside her, smiling at her, relaxed after the tiny mission.
